description: Get predicted high and low tide times and heights for any NOAA CO-OPS tide gauge station in the US, Puerto Rico, Pacific Islands, and Great Lakes. Returns a chronological list of high (H) and low (L) tides with UTC timestamps and water heights. Specify a station_id (e.g. 8443970 for Boston, 9414290 for San Francisco, 8518750 for New York) and optional date range (default: next 7 days). Datum defaults to MLLW (Mean Lower Low Water) — the reference datum used on NOAA nautical charts. Data is generated from harmonic tide predictions. Useful for sailing, fishing, coastal engineering, and flood planning. Source: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS) — tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov. No auth, US Gov public domain.

begin_date.description: Start date for tide predictions in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD format (e.g. 2025-07-04). Defaults to today. Maximum range: 366 days.

datum.description: Vertical datum for water height measurements. MLLW (Mean Lower Low Water) is the chart datum used for nautical charts. MSL = Mean Sea Level. Defaults to MLLW.

end_date.description: End date for tide predictions in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD format (e.g. 2025-07-11). Defaults to 7 days from today. Maximum range: 366 days.

limit.description: Maximum number of tide predictions to return (1–500). Defaults to 100. A 7-day window typically has 28 high/low tides.

station_id.description: NOAA CO-OPS station ID (4–7 digits, e.g. 8443970 for Boston MA). Find station IDs with the coops.tides.stations tool.

units.description: Unit system for water heights. english = feet, metric = meters. Defaults to english.

name: coops.tides.predictions

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: NOAA CO-OPS — Tide High/Low Predictions
